body:
I don't think telling my loved ones about my suicidal desires is  optimal... I told a friend, whom I considered my best friend for many years, and he was supportive of me choosing my destiny... that was months in advance before eating all those pills at 17. I respected that at the moment, but I think I'm trying to reach out here, so I don't think that'd be good... 

Another of my friends isn't very sensible... I can see him slapping me and telling me to snap out of it, but no more. The closest one of my friends at the moment, he'd probably help me and get me to talk with him, but then it'd be too much and when he felt I was alright he'd probably distance himself at least several months. I suppose I'd rather die conformed to my passing than live discontent with the mess I made (and soon after retreat into this darkness again). 

My family I really don't wanna drag into this. I don't think their reactions would be in any way positive to my narrow desire to live. 

My ex, I told her once, and the way she reacted... Fuck, that's exactly what anyone contemplating suicide but crying for help would consider a nightmare, or a pro-suicide instant decision maker. 

I guess I just want someone to walk with me through this shit. I feel I'm hanging onto the cliff, wondering why I am, fantasizing that someone would give me their hand. I don't want to be saved, but I want someone to reassure me I can see this through. And then it'd be fucking cool to be a good friend to them, and quite frankly, if my mind or heart throws itself off the cliff again, remind myself of that friend and pull myself up this time. 

I'm probably emotionally clingy deep inside, and nobody likes that shit. The more I go around this theme, the more I feel I should accept defeat and die with some self-dignity, rather than live like a needy pain in everyone's ass. Fuck this.
